notes: Story levels 2 to 5: the crew and KILN no longer explain the controls in their lines; the arrows and pointers show the way.
Level 3: Sela tells you protein sells for a premium, and once the rockslide is clear you can train Tam to pick greens.
Level 4: the flight recorder is wedged in a crack in the hull. Walk up to it and it rattles loose, bursts out and lands on the sand.
Speech bubbles stay on screen even when the speaker is off it, and every bubble shows the speaker's portrait.
